description: A dark, sleek hull skims or lifts off choppy water, with two large radial-style aero engines and propellers mounted on struts above the deck and a ladder-like strut undercarriage below. A single small figure sits near the cockpit. Behind it are forested hills under a stormy sky, with spray and glare on the water. The painting is loose and painterly, with no visible text, frame or gore.
